kids_evidence: Not a kids/families app: docs/store-policy/Verba.json:126 Apple 1.3 'Kids Category' applies=false ('none of [kids] detected in the current source', generated 2026-10-14); store/apps/Verba.json:32 primary_category EDUCATION. No Kids/Families store metadata found (grep of store/ and docs/). store/ratings/Verba.json read: all content descriptors NONE, advertising true. Category is EDUCATION but the audience is travellers (store/apps/Verba.json:36), not children.

banner.where: none. VerbaBannerAd is defined (lib/core/widgets/ad_banner.dart:9) but no screen instantiates it (grep 'VerbaBannerAd(' in lib: definition only); lib/core/config/verba_config.dart:45 says 'No screen places a banner today'

interstitial.why: Verba does not use AglAds.onTransition. Its own service has showInterstitialIfReady (lib/core/services/monetization_service_mobile.dart:192-210), but nothing calls it (grep in lib outside the service: no hits; verba_config.dart:49 says 'No screen places one today'). Do not add one: a phrase translator is used in quick, task-focused moments at an airport, restaurant or hotel (store/apps/Verba.json:36).

native.why: Translation history is a real scrolling list of items, newest first, capped at 500 (lib/core/data/history_store.dart:17,55). 'History' is one of the founder's allowed feed types. A small template as its own row after every 10th entry fits. The ad row must not be Dismissible or tappable as an entry, and _delete/onDismissed (history_screen.dart:180-192) must map indexes past the ad rows. Not a sensitive-data context under the founder rule (not health, finance or immigration). Deck (lib/features/deck/deck_screen.dart:227-231) is the user's study cards: no native there. CONDITIONAL on founder Q3 keeping AdMob in Verba at all (spec Verba.md:397).

rewarded.existing_limit_or_quota: none in-app. The only quota is upstream: MyMemory's anonymous daily allowance (spec Verba.md:169), which an ad cannot extend. The old Buddy quota_tracker is gone (no lib/core/domain/quota_tracker.dart in the current tree).
rewarded.why: There is no in-app free quota or premium extra. 'Watch an ad for more translations' would be false because the limit is MyMemory's per-connection allowance. The spec also removes every 'Pro/Unlock with Pro' string (Verba.md:200,364).

blockers: Founder Q3 (spec Verba.md:397): keep or remove AdMob in Verba. If it is removed, native = no.

Verba serves ads through its own google_mobile_ads service (lib/core/services/monetization_service_mobile.dart:18-19,119-210) and uses agl_ads only for consent (:85-89). AglAds.configure/initialize is never called, so AglNativeAd would render nothing (ad_native.dart:45-46 returns when AglAds.ids is null). The developer must add AglAds.configure(AglAdIds.fromEnvironment(...)) + initialize first.

pubspec.lock pins agl_ads at f0fc3b2 (pubspec.lock) (pubspec.lock grep), which predates cb21ee5 and has no ad_native.dart (git cat-file checked) - developer must run `flutter pub upgrade agl_ads` before AglNativeAd/showRewarded exist
Verba pins google_mobile_ads ^5.1.0 directly (pubspec.yaml:49), while agl_ads needs >=5.2.0 <10.0.0 (packages/agl_ads/pubspec.yaml:22). The resolver must agree.
store/admob/ad-units-plan.csv rows 469/475 mark the Verba banner 'Shown in app = yes', but the code places no banner (verba_config.dart:45). The CSV is wrong for Verba.
